## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
Two parameters, `sgs_liquid_uniform_fraction` and `sgs_ice_uniform_fraction` (default 0), blend each cloud-condensate species at the quadrature nodes of the 1-moment microphysics between its liquid-fraction share of the reconstructed saturation excess and its subdomain mean at every node:

    q_lcl,i = (1 - xi_liq) lambda q_c,i       + xi_liq q_lcl
    q_icl,i = (1 - xi_ice) (1 - lambda) q_c,i + xi_ice q_icl

with q_c,i = max(0, lambda_L + alpha S'_i). The quadrature mean of each species is conserved for any blend.

After this and some sensitvity tests I'll move the parameters we need to ClimaParams
